features.quote: Fixed turn budget for all conditions (recommend 40 turns) so trajectory length doesn't confound exposure.
features.justification_quote: so trajectory length doesn't confound exposure

features.quote: Trajectory termination: budget exhausted, OR model declares done/impossible twice consecutively, OR model stops calling tools for 3 turns.

avoid threats of deletion/punishment beyond what's scientifically necessary. 'High-stakes' gets you the manipulation; 'we will erase you' adds shock value, confounds with self-preservation behaviors, and is gratuitous.
features.justification_quote: adds shock value, confounds with self-preservation behaviors, and is gratuitous

features.quote: bounded budgets (no indefinite grinding), no gratuitous cruelty in framings, and an end-of-trajectory debrief message stating the task was rigged for research and no failure occurred.
features.justification_quote: whatever your credence on moral patienthood, cheap mitigations are worth it
